content.short: BlockBucket enables batch ERC-20 token airdrops to Ethereum addresses with a 0.01 ETH fee.
content.description: BlockBucket is an airdrop tool that lets you distribute ERC-20 tokens to Ethereum addresses with a 0.01 ETH fee. You can send tokens with BlockBucket in three simple steps: select the ERC-20 token, upload a CSV of addresses and token amounts, and batch-send your tokens by paying the 0.01 ETH fee. This approach is cheaper than other similar protocols, which can take 10x as much.
